title: AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.08572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent. For MAS prompt optimization, textual gradient methods that guide prompt updates using natural-language feedback have emerged as a leading paradigm. In this paper, we identify limitations in two stages of existing textual gradient approaches: gradient extraction and gradient aggregation. In gradient extraction, previous works select a target prompt without verifying whether modifying it resolves the failure, and derive gradients without agent-level supervision over the corresponding agent's intermediate output. In gradient aggregation, individual gradients are randomly grouped and concatenated, often mixing unrelated failure modes and producing prompts that fail to generalize. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AgentGrad}, a prompt op

translated_title: AgentGrad：面向多智能体系统的干预引导式提示优化
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）通过部署多个专门化智能体实现了出色的性能，但其性能依赖于每个智能体的提示设计。对于多智能体系统的提示优化，利用自然语言反馈引导提示更新的文本梯度方法已成为主导范式。在本文中，我们指出了现有文本梯度方法在两个阶段中的局限性：梯度提取和梯度聚合。在梯度提取方面，先前的工作在选择目标提示时未验证修改该提示是否能够解决失败问题，且在推导梯度时缺乏针对相应智能体中间输出的智能体级别监督。在梯度聚合方面，各个梯度被随机分组和拼接，常常混合了不相关的失败模式，导致生成的提示无法泛化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了AgentGrad，一种提示优化方法……
tldr: 提出AgentGrad方法，通过干预引导机制验证并选择真正有效的目标提示、提供智能体级别的梯度监督，并改进梯度聚合策略以避免混合无关失败模式，从而显著提升多智能体系统的提示优化效果。
en_tdlr: AgentGrad enhances textual gradient-based prompt optimization for multi-agent systems by using intervention guidance to verify target prompt selection, providing agent-level supervision during gradient extraction, and improving gradient aggregation to avoid mixing unrelated failure modes.
